history: 82e91f66d4c4733f2b53429a3f49870526fab19b adds the structured medium-tail branch and a regression on a 14-token tail. The same method retains the existing long period-eight shortcut. These excerpts isolate the two guards, pass the precomputed statistics or period to the guard, and return false when it does not apply. The medium-tail target uses the token sequence from the added regression.

variants.issue: This is the extra speculative-decoding risk rule for medium chunks. It covers at least 12 tokens, before the long-chunk policy applies, and requires a full suffix match.
variants.template:
def risky_medium_tail?(ids : Array(Int32), min_size : Int32, match_len : Int32,
                       pair_unique : Float64, entropy : Float64, lag4 : Float64, lag8 : Float64) : Bool
  if ids.size >= 12 && <HOLE> && match_len >= 8
    return pair_unique >= 0.95 && entropy >= 0.80 && lag4 < 0.10 && lag8 < 0.10
  end
  false
end
variants.target:
ids = [198, 220, 471, 850, 25, 221, 17, 199, 262, 803, 26, 8029, 869, 320]
raise "missed structured medium tail" unless risky_medium_tail?(ids, 16, 8, 1.0, 0.99, 0.0, 0.0)
variants.regressions:
ids = (1..14).to_a
raise "admitted a short match" if risky_medium_tail?(ids, 16, 7, 1.0, 0.99, 0.0, 0.0)
raise "admitted strong lag reuse" if risky_medium_tail?(ids, 16, 8, 1.0, 0.99, 0.5, 0.0)
raise "used the medium rule at the long boundary" if risky_medium_tail?((1..16).to_a, 16, 8, 1.0, 0.99, 0.0, 0.0)

variants.issue: This is the period-eight shortcut for long speculative-decoding chunks. The configured minimum is the first long size. Short repeats use a separate policy with more checks.
variants.template:
def risky_long_period?(ids : Array(Int32), min_size : Int32, period : Int32) : Bool
  return true if <HOLE> && period == 8
  false
end
variants.target:
period8 = (1..8).to_a
raise "missed a long repeat at the boundary" unless risky_long_period?(period8 + period8, 16, 8)
variants.regressions:
period8 = (1..8).to_a
raise "applied the long shortcut to a short repeat" if risky_long_period?(period8 + period8.first(6), 16, 8)
raise "admitted a different period" if risky_long_period?([1, 2, 3, 4] * 4, 16, 4)
raise "admitted an aperiodic tail" if risky_long_period?((1..20).to_a, 16, 0)
